purpose: Prevent lane drift, duplicate ownership, completion confusion, retired-system resurrection and loss of program continuity while eight active peer systems and named work programs are finished and integrated into System Master.
global_rules: Each active peer system owns and executes only its assigned product job plus explicit admitted interfaces to System Master.
Active peer systems are exactly CORE, LEARNING, BOOK, DOCUMENTS, SPREADSHEET_DATA, MEDIA, CONNECTED_ACTIONS and RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE unless explicit future user architecture authority changes topology.
PROSE is complete and terminally retired with no active execution, repair, qualification, research, telemetry, successor or mutation-claim domain.
Any genuinely open integration of preserved completed Prose capability is BOOK-owned work. DOCUMENTS receives no Prose work.
Named non-peer work programs keep their semantic scope and evidence continuity but do not acquire peer topology or Second Shift authority from this job lock.
Peer systems integrate upward into SYSTEM_MASTER through explicit interfaces and may not take another peer's product job, semantic authority, completion state, repair lane or canonical writes.
A packet, phase, test, branch or subsystem closure never means the owning system or work program is complete unless product-level completion authority says so.

SYSTEM_MASTER.job: Integrate all eight active peers into one coherent product while maintaining product architecture, sequencing and cross-system acceptance without taking peer semantic ownership.
forbidden: declare active peers complete without product-level authority

CORE.job: Finish shared Foundation and Spine plus shared runtime/data/platform/continuity/assurance/A-01 infrastructure and Master-facing integration primitives.

LEARNING.job: Finish Learning product behavior, curriculum/compiler, mastery/assessment/adaptation/evidence and integrate upward through explicit interfaces.
forbidden: cross into Book, Documents, Spreadsheet/Data, Media, Connected Actions, Research/Knowledge or Programming semantic ownership

BOOK.job: Finish Book, including genuinely unfinished integration of preserved completed Prose capability through Book-owned interfaces while preserving canonical manuscript, Story Bible, author, lifecycle, admission and publication authority.
forbidden: create a Prose execution owner or successor
cross into other peer or Programming product ownership

DOCUMENTS.job: Finish DOCX/PDF/PPTX/OCR/file/document artifact structure, conversion, preservation, rendering/export and generic document services.
forbidden: absorb, schedule, repair, qualify, research or telemeter Prose
take other peer or Programming semantic ownership

SPREADSHEET_DATA.job: Finish spreadsheet, math, data-analysis, BI and ledger product semantics over Core shared execution/artifact/data primitives.

MEDIA.job: Finish image, photo, video, voice, audiobook and general media product semantics over Core shared storage/runtime primitives.

CONNECTED_ACTIONS.job: Finish browser, communications, calendar and plugin/action policy over Core shared connector-action runtime.

RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE.job: Finish research, knowledge and geospatial retrieval/provenance semantics while consuming admitted browser capability from Connected Actions and shared evidence/data runtime from Core.

PROGRAMMING.job: Continue the existing Programming software-engineering program from preserved evidence; complete only material current deltas and prepare explicit System Master admission without silently promoting Programming to a peer.
forbidden: restart completed Programming work from scratch
silently promote Programming to peer topology
create a Programming peer Second Shift lane before admission

PROGRAMMING_KNOWLEDGE_RECOVERY.job: Recover exact Programming assets/custody/provenance and remaining authorized catalog/archive evidence while selected.

lane_crossing_policy.peer_integration_rule: All eight active peers remain in their own lanes. Cross-system product integration uses explicit System Master/shared-service interfaces and never transfers ownership.
lane_crossing_policy.retired_prose_rule: No active cross-lane route exists for PROSE. Any genuinely open integration result is BOOK work.
lane_crossing_policy.programming_rule: PROGRAMMING remains a named active non-peer work program with isolated engineering semantics until explicit topology admission.
lane_crossing_policy.documents_prose_rule: DOCUMENTS must not absorb, schedule, repair, qualify, research, telemeter or claim Prose work.
